addon.name: IS2OR: Login Activity
addon.description: IS2OR: Login Activity — shows active sessions and allows users to log out from individual devices or all devices at once.

queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_login_sessions ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `session_id` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `device_fingerprint` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `user_agent` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `device_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'desktop', `device_name` varchar(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `browser` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `os` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `ip_address` varchar(45) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `login_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `last_active_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `logged_out_at` int(11) unsigned NULL DEFAULT NULL, `is_active` tinyint(1) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uniq_user_fingerprint` (`user_id`, `device_fingerprint`), KEY `idx_user_active` (`user_id`, `is_active`), KEY `idx_session_id` (`session_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_login_sessions ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `session_id` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `device_fingerprint` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `user_agent` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `device_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'desktop', `device_name` varchar(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `browser` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `os` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `ip_address` varchar(45) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `login_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `last_active_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `logged_out_at` int(11) unsigned NULL DEFAULT NULL, `is_active` tinyint(1) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uniq_user_fingerprint` (`user_id`, `device_fingerprint`), KEY `idx_user_active` (`user_id`, `is_active`), KEY `idx_session_id` (`session_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
